_comment: PAGES THAT CARRY LIVE AD SPEND. The studio refuses to deploy a build that changes any of these until someone explicitly confirms it, route by route (server/protected.mjs). This file is the list — edit it here, in a commit, not in the studio UI, so adding or removing a protected page is a reviewable change rather than a click. A route is the path as served, without a trailing slash.
_note_on_comparison: The comparison ignores the content-hashed bundle filenames (index-<hash>.js / .css). Those change whenever ANY shared code changes, so treating them as a difference would make every publish require a confirmation and the confirmation would stop meaning anything. Everything else in the HTML — copy, phone numbers, photos, GTM, the robots meta — is compared byte for byte.
